fact: Uganda's NITA-U and Tanzania's TTCL signed an MoU in September 2023, and in 2026 UETCL was directed to progress the Masaka-Kyaka optical fibre project on the planned Masaka-Mutukula-Mwanza line, with the Uganda-Tanzania fibre connection still being negotiated.
title: Questions swirl over internet deal between Uganda, Tanzania
